rule.initialPosition: Preserve actual worldX/Y and fractional remainder; no additional offset or teleport.
rule.order: Contact frame has no X/Y displacement. First movement on following active update; position before gravity, then cap downward velocity.
rule.render: Reverse the two visible8px rows and flipY each tile, preserving raw16x16body origin.
rule.renderPhase: Default immediate flip; source0..1native contact-render delay is retained as explicit presentation uncertainty, within2native timing tolerance.
